label: Laravel (PHP)

rules: Run tests with APP_ENV=testing and the test database from .env.testing / phpunit.xml only.
Never run migrate:fresh, db:wipe or migrate:refresh against the application database.
Prefer RefreshDatabase or DatabaseTransactions in tests.

architect_triggers: public API route or resource change
queues, jobs, scheduled tasks or external integration
change touching several modules or shared services
review_checklist: authorization via policies/gates on every changed route
mass assignment and personal data exposure
